route_warnings: Codex CLI fixes the requested model but its retained envelope does not independently attest runtime identity

items.material_issue: The historical sequence, actors, resources, military strategy, threat, and price increase are substantively preserved.
items.evidence: The target retains the old king's ruinous policies, Drake's stealth-and-stralite strategy, the threat to destroy the deposits, and the final thirtyfold payment.

items.material_issue: The duration, three timelines, and choice of the real timeline are all preserved.
items.evidence: “%d turns in three different timelines” corresponds to “三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合”.

items.material_issue: The reversal and renewed belief that life may be worth living are preserved.
items.evidence: “perhaps life is still worth it” is rendered as “生命或许依然值得活下去”.

items.material_issue: The target omits that the orb was used as the means of traveling from Maj'Eyal, weakening the reason it is identified as the Orb of Many Ways.
items.evidence: The source says “That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal?”, while the target merely says “你说你是从马基·埃亚尔来的？”.

items.material_issue: Context is needed to determine whether “these” are specifically raw materials; the target adds that identification.
items.evidence: The source only says “take these,” whereas the target says “收下这些原料”.

items.material_issue: The cries, obstruction by the listener's men, and request for an explanation are preserved.
items.evidence: “your men... they were in my way” corresponds to “你的人……挡了我的路”.

items.material_issue: The target adds active Gestalt as a mandatory condition, changing the source's two-way alternative into a stricter logical requirement.
items.evidence: The source requires either “a psionic damage shield active” or “Improved Gestalt available”; the target requires “格式塔处于激活状态，并且” one of the other conditions.

items.material_issue: The timing and action of checking the ranking boards before entry are preserved.
items.evidence: “before entering” and “take a look at the ranking boards” correspond to “进入竞技场前” and “查看了一下排名榜”.

items.material_issue: The target omits the narrative fact that the speaker personally met the apprentice mage in the wilds.
items.evidence: The source says “that apprentice mage I met in the wilds,” but the target only identifies “那个荒野之中的法师学徒”.

items.material_issue: The gold cost and numeric placeholder are preserved.
The target reverses the qualification that the war was only technically concluded, presenting it as a genuine substantive conclusion.
items.evidence: The source says “technically brought the Allure Wars ... to their ... conclusion,” while the target says “终于迎来了真正的结束” (“finally reached a true ending”).

items.material_issue: Repeated implosions are mistranslated as explosions occurring inside the subjects, changing the physical outcome and its contrast with the explicitly exploded subject D.
items.evidence: “Imploded during transition” is rendered as “在传送过程中体内发生爆裂”; implosion is inward collapse, not an internal explosion.

items.material_issue: The construct's unfinished but functional state, protective purpose, expected invulnerability, and intended subjugation are preserved.
items.evidence: “unfinished,” “protecting my lair,” “nigh invulnerable,” and “bend it to my will” all have corresponding statements in the target.

items.material_issue: The interpolated value and runtime context are needed to verify whether the created object is necessarily a bottled concoction.
items.evidence: The source generically says “create a %s,” while the target specifies “配制出了一瓶%s” (“concoct a bottle of %s”).
